select IFNULL(temp.fprod_id,temp.prod_id) as prodId,temp.settdate_date as mdate from (select deal.prod_id, deal.fprod_id, deal.settdate_date from chb_prd_deal deal where IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(deal.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d'),DATE_FORMAT(deal.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')) <= #{batchDate,jdbcType = VARCHAR} and deal.trade_type = #{tradType,jdbcType = VARCHAR} and deal.status in ('E', 'D','M') union all select deal.prod_id, deal.fprod_id, deal.settdate_date from chb_prd_deal deal where DATE_FORMAT(deal.settdate_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{batchDate,jdbcType = VARCHAR} and deal.trade_type = #{tradType,jdbcType = VARCHAR} and deal.status in ('E', 'D','M') union all select feeinfo.prod_id, feeinfo.fprod_id,deal1.settdate_date from (select fee.prod_id, fee.fprod_id from chb_prd_fee_deal fee where IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(fee.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d'),DATE_FORMAT(fee.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')) = #{batchDate,jdbcType = VARCHAR} and fee.status in ('E','D','M') group by fee.prod_id, fee.fprod_id) feeinfo inner join chb_prd_deal deal1 on deal1.prod_id = feeinfo.prod_id and deal1.trade_type = #{tradType,jdbcType = VARCHAR} and DATE_FORMAT(deal1.settdate_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{batchDate,jdbcType = VARCHAR} and deal1.status in('E','M')) temp where 1=1
and IFNULL(temp.fprod_id,temp.prod_id) in
#{dto,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
